# invoice-extractor

> Extract invoices and receipts from text into validated JSON with Decimal arithmetic checks per ISO 4217 minor units and a bounded LLM repair loop. Python package `trysac-invoice-extractor`, import name `invoice_extractor`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
